notes:
Topline: Northwall is a federal contractor running critical mission workloads requiring an air-gapped, on-prem Redwood Private deployment inside a SCIF. They want vendor-offered turnkey appliance + on-site install; HSM integration (customer FIPS 140-2 HSM) is non-negotiable.

Background:
- Prime contractor for multi-agency situational awareness program. Sensitive PII and classified-adjacent metadata handled in enclave.
- Evaluating vendors for a single-vendor private inference stack to minimize operational footprint.

Security & compliance constraints (customer vocal):
- "Must never phone home" — outbound egress blocked by default.
- FIPS 140-2 validated HSM for key custody; require HSM vendor & Redwood OPS runbook review.
- Audit logging retention 7 years; immutable logs and tamper-evident delivery into their SIEM.
- SSO via SAML with IdP cert rollover monthly cadence.

Technical requirements & targets:

- Throughput: sustain 200 concurrent sessions + batch offline rerank jobs (throughput spike tolerance built into Dedicated).
- Model constraints: prefer quantized LLM variants (8-bit/4-bit) validated for determinism; must support offline model artifact signing and local verification.
- Caching: prefix/KV caching acceptable but cache lifetime must be configurable and purged on-demand.
